text:
emily: Heads up — Ravenbrook dedicated rollout is queued for the maintenance window on Thu 03/25 23:00 UTC. Need final go/no-go and pin confirmation. Release notes -> https://internal.redwood/ravenbrook/v2.14.0/notes :eyes:

emily: Key items: pinned model v2.14.0, quantization profile q8_eco, canary on 10% slice, automatic fallback to v2.13.3, KMS key rotation already completed.

ryan: thanks — I ran the preflight smoke earlier, latency graphs looked fine for 512 seq. I pushed a tiny change to canary routing. Patch id: abc123.

sanjay: what's our rollback threshold? is 4xx spike >2% still the agreed cutoff? also confirm no db migration for this customer.

ryan: yes 4xx >2% sustained over 5m or p50 request latency +200ms over baseline -> rollback. No DB changes, pure serving config + model.

deploybot: [deploybot] scheduled job created by emily for customer=ravenbrook env=dedicated version=v2.14.0 window=2026-03-25T23:00Z canary=10% fallback=v2.13.3

emily: Quick checklist I shared in the release notes: run smoke tests, sanity prompts, KV-cache priming, and verify metrics ingestion to console. I added a post-deploy eval with 12 prompts.

mia: I can run the post-deploy eval and smoke tests during the window. Will report within 10m after canary.

ops-bot: ops-bot note: Reserved capacity already allocated (slice-43). Autoscale policy set to conservative for first 15m. Alerts created: ravenbrook-4xx, ravenbrook-p50-latency, ravenbrook-error-rate.

sanjay: ack from security: KMS audit log shows last rotation 3 days ago, no outstanding alerts. Good.

mia: ran local smoke (generation + chat) against canary endpoint, sample outputs OK. I'll run the official 12-prompt eval once canary flips.

ryan: one more piece — version pinning config in config store: 
```
customer: ravenbrook
env: dedicated
model_pin: v2.14.0
fallback: v2.13.3
quant_profile: q8_eco
canary_pct: 10
```

emily: Approvals: @ryan (eng), @sanjay (sec), @mia (qa). Please react with :thumbsup: to approve.

mia: :thumbsup: — I'll post results in this thread within 10m of canary.

ryan: :thumbsup:

sanjay: :thumbsup: security ok.

deploybot: [deploybot] executing: start-deploy --customer ravenbrook --env dedicated --version v2.14.0 --canary 10

deploybot: [deploybot] canary 10% applied -> slice-43-canary, health checks passing (3/3).

mia: Post-canary eval: 12/12 prompts good, no hallucination regression, latency within baseline.

ops-bot: Monitoring: 4xx=0.14%, p50=24ms (baseline 22ms). No alerts firing.

emily: Great — rolling to full traffic over next 20m. Keeping autoscale conservative, will pause if thresholds breach.

deploybot: [deploybot] rolling traffic: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (stagger 5m intervals).

ryan: will keep an eye on tracing for any tokenization errors.

sanjay: security watching logs for any abnormal access.

deploybot: [deploybot] rollout complete: 100% traffic on v2.14.0. No automatic fallback triggered.

mia: Done — final verification successful. Posting summary in release notes and creating a follow-up ticket for perf regression baseline capture.

emily: Thanks team. Marking Ravenbrook dedicated rollout as complete. Will update the customer-facing release note and close the change window. :white_check_mark:
